completed_frontier.name: LIVE_BEHAVIOR_EFFECT_VERIFICATION
invariants: A matching RUNTIME_CONSUME_VERIFY for the same consumer is mandatory.
The matching runtime consumer must be live-current PASS before behavior/effect qualification can run.
Runtime-consumption PASS is only a prerequisite; it never becomes behavior/effect PASS.
Behavior/effect evidence binds the exact runtime-consumption receipt, process instance, runtime-state digest, declared stimulus digest, and declared outcome digest.
Live host/external evidence must refresh to the exact stored PASS; stored PASS alone is historical evidence.
BEHAVIOR evidence cannot claim an external effect receipt.
EFFECT evidence requires an exact external effect id and external effect receipt digest.
Process/state changes, evidence-byte changes, effect-receipt changes, or loss of live evidence transport invalidate current qualification.
Task closeout cannot mark a declared behavior/effect surface current until all declared probes are live-current PASS.
Behavior/effect receipt digests are automatically included in task closeout evidence.
Task runtime evidence cut now includes the behavior/effect verification head.

next_frontier.name: DECLARATION_BOUND_EXTERNAL_BEHAVIOR_ATTESTATION
objectives: Bind each behavior probe to an exact canonical behavior declaration/profile digest rather than only task-local stimulus/outcome hashes.
Add a host/external evidence-provider identity and attestation contract so exact evidence provenance can be verified without treating the Vera runtime as its own behavioral grader.

Implement a concrete host-bound behavior probe transport that records exact stimulus, exact raw response/effect evidence, process/runtime identity, evidence-provider identity, and signed or otherwise verifier-bound receipt.
For EFFECT probes, cross-check external provider/host effect receipts against the declared effect subject without treating Vera's local effect fence as external proof.
Add held-out/adversarial probe fixtures and stale-process, stale-profile, forged-attestation, replay, mismatched-stimulus, and mismatched-outcome tests.
Keep independent behavioral review distinct from internal qualification and do not infer consciousness, phenomenology, deployment, provider activation, or protected-effect authority.
